entries.title: Job 15:1
segments: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said,

entries.title: Job 15:2
segments: Should a wise man make answer with vain knowledge, And fill himself with the east wind?

entries.title: Job 15:3
segments: Should he reason with unprofitable talk, Or with speeches wherewith he can do no good?

entries.title: Job 15:4
segments: Yea, thou doest away with fear, And hinderest devotion before God.

entries.title: Job 15:5
segments: For thine iniquity teacheth thy mouth, And thou choosest the tongue of the crafty.

entries.title: Job 15:6
segments: Thine own mouth condemneth thee, and not I; Yea, thine own lips testify against thee.

entries.title: Job 15:7
segments: Art thou the first man that was born? Or wast thou brought forth before the hills?

entries.title: Job 15:8
segments: Hast thou heard the secret counsel of God? And dost thou limit wisdom to thyself?

entries.title: Job 15:9
segments: What knowest thou, that we know not? What understandest thou, which is not in us?

entries.title: Job 15:10
segments: With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, Much elder than thy father.

entries.title: Job 15:11
segments: Are the consolations of God too small for thee, Even the word that is gentle toward thee?

entries.title: Job 15:12
segments: Why doth thy heart carry thee away? And why do thine eyes flash,

entries.title: Job 15:13
segments: That against God thou turnest thy spirit, And lettest words go out of thy mouth?

entries.title: Job 15:14
segments: What is man, that he should be clean? And he that is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?

entries.title: Job 15:15
segments: Behold, he putteth no trust in his holy ones; Yea, the heavens are not clean in his sight:

entries.title: Job 15:16
segments: How much less one that is abominable and corrupt, A man that drinketh iniquity like water!

entries.title: Job 15:17
segments: I will show thee, hear thou me; And that which I have seen I will declare:

entries.title: Job 15:18
segments: (Which wise men have told From their fathers, and have not hid it;

entries.title: Job 15:19
segments: Unto whom alone the land was given, And no stranger passed among them):

entries.title: Job 15:20
segments: The wicked man travaileth with pain all his days, Even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor.

entries.title: Job 15:21
segments: A sound of terrors is in his ears; In prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him.

entries.title: Job 15:22
segments: He believeth not that he shall return out of darkness, And he is waited for of the sword.

entries.title: Job 15:23
segments: He wandereth abroad for bread, [saying], Where is it? He knoweth that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.

entries.title: Job 15:24
segments: Distress and anguish make him afraid; They prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.

entries.title: Job 15:25
segments: Because he hath stretched out his hand against God, And behaveth himself proudly against the Almighty;

entries.title: Job 15:26
segments: He runneth upon him with a [stiff] neck, With the thick bosses of his bucklers;

entries.title: Job 15:27
segments: Because he hath covered his face with his fatness, And gathered fat upon his loins;

entries.title: Job 15:28
segments: And he hath dwelt in desolate cities, In houses which no man inhabited, Which were ready to become heaps;

entries.title: Job 15:29
segments: He shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue, Neither shall their possessions be extended on the earth.

entries.title: Job 15:30
segments: He shall not depart out of darkness; The flame shall dry up his branches, And by the breath of [God's] mouth shall he go away.

entries.title: Job 15:31
segments: Let him not trust in vanity, deceiving himself; For vanity shall be his recompense.

entries.title: Job 15:32
segments: It shall be accomplished before his time, And his branch shall not be green.

entries.title: Job 15:33
segments: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, And shall cast off his flower as the olive-tree.

entries.title: Job 15:34
segments: For the company of the godless shall be barren, And fire shall consume the tents of bribery.

entries.title: Job 15:35
segments: They conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity, And their heart prepareth deceit.
